title: Harden stale audit close readiness
summary: Made backend close-readiness and snapshot progress bars freshness-aware for audit progress. Stale audit_progress.json no longer derives an active audit state or active progress bars.
reason: A stale audit_progress.json could still make the backend close-readiness DTO report active work, which downstream UI surfaces trusted for start/stop/close guidance.
behavior_before: When a snapshot had stale active-looking audit progress and no live pipeline progress, close-readiness could report safe_to_close=false, active_work=true, state=audit. Backend progress bars also emitted active audit bars from the stale audit file.
behavior_after: Stale or terminal audit progress is ignored when deriving close-readiness state, and backend audit progress bars carry stale=true with warning status. Fresh audit progress still reports active audit state and active bars.
tests_added: tests.python.desktop.test_application_facade_close_readiness covers stale audit progress without live work returning safe close-readiness
tests.python.desktop.test_application_facade_snapshot covers stale backend audit progress bars as warning/stale review evidence
manual_validation: PASS: stale audit reproduction fixture now returns safe_to_close=True, active_work=False, state=idle
rollback_plan: Revert the audit-staleness check in src/mediapipeline/core/application/utilities.py, the stale audit progress-bar plumbing in src/mediapipeline/core/observability/status_policy.py, the two regression tests, and the refreshed generated summaries.
notes:
Ignore stale or terminal audit progress when deriving close-readiness state.
Mark stale audit progress bars as warning/stale in backend snapshot DTOs.
Cover stale audit progress no longer making close-readiness active.
Cover backend stale audit progress bars as review evidence.
Refresh summary after stale-audit close-readiness state fix.
Refresh summary after stale audit progress bar status fix.

Python impact: backend status/close-readiness policy and Python tests only; no media engine, source/scratch/output mutation, route contract, or filesystem movement behavior changed.
